analysis.title: The AI bears have a Taiwan problem
key_insights: Taiwan equities are printing fresh all-time highs while the market debates whether the AI trade has gone too far.
GS sales notes say Taiwan's retail bid remains extremely strong. Margin balances have risen for 10 straight sessions, with TWSE balances 0.2% below all-time highs and TPEx balances at a record.
Relative to market cap, Taiwan retail leverage remains below the July highs, which suggests room for local retail sentiment to run further.

JPM says the earnings backdrop for Taiwan hardware is intact, with steady EPS revisions and no imminent capex downturn priced in. TSMC is the key validation point, with AI accelerator demand and 100%+ utilization at N3/N5.
Taiwan IC revenues grew around 23% last year and are expected to rise another 41% in 2026.
Franklin Templeton says consensus expects Taiwan EPS growth of more than 50% in 2026.
Foreign investors sold Taiwan aggressively over the summer and cumulative foreign positioning remains light despite the breakout, leaving potential buyers on the sidelines.

JPM estimates around 55% of TWSE market cap has positive Apple exposure. After major Apple upgrade cycles, Taiwan supply-chain forward EPS revisions have historically risen around 9% in the following three months.
TSMC says customer engagement on leading-edge technology now begins at least two to three years in advance, which gives visibility into customers' multi-year production plans.
JPM likes buying Dec 2026 TWSE 110% calls. Taiwan vol has normalized from the recent spike, which makes outright upside calls a cleaner way to play further upside.
